blk_part_04_part_4_occupation_and_restor.text: In August 1939, the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact placed the Baltic states in the Soviet sphere. The Soviet Union occupied Lithuania in June 1940. Nazi Germany occupied it in 1941, and Soviet forces returned in 1944. Anti-Soviet partisans continued fighting into the early 1950s, while about 130,000 Lithuanians were deported to Siberia.
